spans.s:
(ऋ) खोऌ r. 1st cl. (खोलति)
To be lame, to limp, to be prevented from moving. खोड, खोर, &c. are conceived by some authorities to be mere variations in the form of this root.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Lame.
E.
खोल to be lame, affix अच्; also खोर, &c.

m. (-कः)
1 A helmet, armour for the head.
2 A pot, a saucepan.
3 An ant hill.
4 The shell of the betel nut.
E.
खुड to cover, affix ण्वुल्, ड changed to ल.

m. (-ल्कः)
1 A meteor.
2 A planet.
E.
ख, and उल्का torch.

m. (-कः)
The planet MARS.
E.
ख heaven, उल्मुक^1 a hot coal.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301. note: Print unclear.
